'''Imperial File #13474.8c''' was an internal [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] report detailing individuals and incidents connected to the rescue of [[Princess/Legends|Princess]] [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa]] from the [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station/Legends|Death Star]] and the subsequent [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]].
